description: Free Blue Lock quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Isagi, Bachira, Nagi, Reo, Chigiri, Kunigami, Barou or Rin. Unofficial Blue Lock fan quiz, no spoilers, no sign-up.
h1: Which Blue Lock character are you?
lede: Reading the whole field like Isagi, dribbling for fun like Bachira or a lazy genius like Nagi? Answer 12 questions to find your Blue Lock striker.
about: Blue Lock, a soccer manga written by Muneyuki Kaneshiro and drawn by Yusuke Nomura since 2018, with an anime since 2022, follows 300 young strikers locked in a training facility to find the world's most egotistical striker for Japan. Its players are as different as their skills: analytical Yoichi Isagi; free-spirited dribbler Meguru Bachira; Seishiro Nagi, the genius who finds everything a hassle; ambitious, adaptable Reo Mikage; Hyoma Chigiri, the fastest of them all; Rensuke Kunigami, who wants to be a hero; self-proclaimed king Shoei Barou; and cool, precise Rin Itoshi. This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. The questions are about personality and playing style, not story events, so there are no spoilers. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the creators, Kodansha or the anime studio; the names belong to their owners.

isagi.name: Yoichi Isagi
isagi.body: You're analytical, adaptable and always learning. You see the whole field, read what others will do and find the gap nobody else noticed. You may not look like a star at first, but every rival makes you better. Trust your instincts as much as your analysis.

bachira.name: Meguru Bachira
bachira.body: You're playful, creative and a true free spirit. You do things your own way, you follow what feels fun and you're happiest with someone who gets your style. People may call you weird; you call it being yourself. Your joy is contagious.

nagi.name: Seishiro Nagi
nagi.body: You're a natural talent who finds most things a hassle. You make hard things look effortless, you're calm under pressure and you don't waste energy on what doesn't matter. Once something sparks your interest, watch out. Find the challenge that makes you care.

reo.name: Reo Mikage
reo.body: You're ambitious, versatile and good at almost anything you try. You set big goals, pick up new skills fast and know how to bring people together. You're generous with your time and your resources. Remember that your own talent is enough; it doesn't depend on anyone else.

chigiri.name: Hyoma Chigiri
chigiri.body: You're fast, proud and more determined than you let on. You take care of yourself, you know what you're good at and you can leave everyone behind when you go all in. Past setbacks may make you hesitate, but when you let go of the fear, nobody can catch you.

kunigami.name: Rensuke Kunigami
kunigami.body: You're honest, hard-working and a hero at heart. You play fair, you train hard and you stand up for others. People trust you because you mean what you say. Your straightforward strength is rare; don't let anyone tell you being kind makes you less of a competitor.

barou.name: Shoei Barou
barou.body: You're confident, driven and you believe in yourself completely. You set your own rules, you hate losing and you'd rather take the shot than pass the chance to someone else. Behind the attitude is someone who works harder than anyone. Let others in on the game now and then.

rin.name: Rin Itoshi
rin.body: You're precise, intense and set on being the best. You hold yourself and others to very high standards, and you rarely show how much you care. Your focus is remarkable. Make sure you're chasing your own dream, not just measuring yourself against someone else.
